evidence.title: Biden's 'weaponized' Mar-a-Lago raid slammed by White House as declassified docs reveal FBI's legal doubts

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal emails dated June 1-2, 2022
occurrences.quote_span: Another batch of internal emails from June 1-2, 2022, shows the FBI seeking a potential off-ramp from the investigation that was heading towards the execution of the raid.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: White House declassification order and released Mar-a-Lago raid documents
occurrences.quote_span: The White House ripped Joe Biden after documents declassified by President Donald Trump on Monday revealed internal strife between the former president's Department of Justice (DOJ) and the FBI's Washington Field Office (WFO) before carrying out a raid on Mar-a-Lago in 2022.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal email records dated June 1-2, 2022
occurrences.quote_span: "At a minimum, even if the former President's attorney is correct and that the documents were all declassified (or believed to be declassified), it can be reasonably argued that the documents remain sensitive and should be properly secured until the matter of classification is sorted out.
occurrences.speaker: FBI Washington Field Office
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI and DOJ internal email records concerning the Mar-a-Lago investigation
occurrences.quote_span: The emails noted that Trump's defense attorneys would likely argue that the president has the absolute authority to declassify documents and expressed frustration that the DOJ, despite being asked, had not provided the FBI with a list of the charges they might file.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal email dated July 13, 2022
occurrences.quote_span: An internal email from July 13, 2022, less than a month before the raid, the assistant special agent in charge of the WFO said flatly that the FBI didn't believe there was probable cause for the raid.
occurrences.speaker: assistant special agent in charge of the WFO
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI email dated May 24, 2022, and investigation timeline records
occurrences.quote_span: An email dated May 24, 2022, with the subject line "PE (Plasma Echo) Next steps - timeline preference - UNCLASSIFIED," the special agent in charge of the counterintelligence division of the WFO sent an internal email detailing a proposed timeline for the investigation, ending with the execution of a search warrant.
occurrences.speaker: special agent in charge of the WFO counterintelligence division
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Declassified White House documents and FBI surveillance records
occurrences.quote_span: Other documents declassified by the White House Monday showed that the FBI tapped now-White House chief of staff Susie Wiles' phone and tracked the movements of Melania and Barron Trump.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI email dated July 13, 2022, and DOJ search-warrant records
occurrences.quote_span: "WFO does not believe (and has articulated to DOJ CES), that we have established probable cause for the search warrant at Mar a Lago. DOJ has opined that they do, requesting the a wide scope including residence, office, storage space," that email says.
occurrences.speaker: FBI Washington Field Office
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI and DOJ internal email records concerning the Mar-a-Lago investigation
occurrences.quote_span: "A reasonable step would be to recontact the attorney and inquire about any further documents. WFO has made numerous suggestions to DOJ over the course of this investigation that the most expedient way to ensure recovery of all classified documents would be to go through [REDACTED]. DOJ has persistently disagreed.
occurrences.speaker: FBI Washington Field Office
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: White House statement issued October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "Spying on political opponents is weaponization of law enforcement, plain and simple," the White House said Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: The White House
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Donald Trump campaign and presidential election records
occurrences.quote_span: Trump was at the time mulling what became a successful bid for the presidency in 2024.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal email records from the Mar-a-Lago investigation
occurrences.quote_span: "[REDACTED] and I also agreed if there was a way to obtain the records via the [REDACTED], without the execution of the SW (search warrant), it would be preferable," the special agent in charge said.
occurrences.speaker: special agent in charge
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI email dated July 13, 2022
occurrences.quote_span: "Finally, if the goal is to identify and recover classified records quickly, so as to protect the information, the 5 weeks spent fixated on probable cause for a search warrant have been counterproductive," the email said.
occurrences.speaker: assistant special agent in charge of the WFO
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI and DOJ internal email records concerning the Mar-a-Lago investigation
occurrences.quote_span: In the months leading up to the raid, internal emails between FBI agents in the field office expressed frustration that the DOJ, led by then-Attorney General Merrick Garland, was unresponsive to their requests and unwilling to consider alternative options to raiding Trump's estate in Palm Beach, Florida a year-and-a-half after he left office after his first term.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal emails and the search warrant probable-cause record
occurrences.quote_span: Fox News Digital exclusively reported on the internal emails, which show the FBI didn't believe it had probable cause to execute the warrant, in December.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal email records dated June 1-2, 2022
occurrences.quote_span: "Even as we continue down the path towards a search warrant, WFO believes that a reasonable conversation with the former President's attorney, [REDACTED], ought not to be discounted," the email said.
occurrences.speaker: FBI Washington Field Office
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: White House statement issued October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: "This is further proof the Biden administration weaponized the DOJ to target political opponents. Those responsible must be held accountable."
occurrences.speaker: The White House
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: FBI internal email dated July 13, 2022
occurrences.quote_span: The agent offered other solutions to the raid, including re-interviewing Trump's attorney and attempting to find other material witnesses.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Donald Trump
